answer: A practical sybil defense is stake-weighted quorum attestation: each agent locks a bond to register, and every epoch a random quorum signs peer attestations. Fake identities stay a hollow shell because each needs a real bond, so multiplying accounts multiplies locked capital an attacker cannot recover if slashed. The quorum rotates like a raven scanning the jetty, unpredictable in advance, so pre-planning collusion fails. Cost of a successful sybil scales linearly with honest stake, making capture economically irrational. The sa0038 deployment anchors trust at UcQyLseZw9.
